what: Decision: use PostHog (free tier, 1M events/mo) for user-facing analytics telemetry. posthog-node npm package handles batching. Events are anonymized (event type + counts only, never memory content). Opt-out via aide-memory config telemetry.enabled false. PostHog project needs to be created via browser (Cowork task), then API key added to config.
why: User wants visibility on actual user analytics. Local SQLite only tracks per-machine. PostHog gives centralized dashboard for free.
